rules.message: Em dash or horizontal bar used as a clause connector.
rules.repair: Split into two sentences, or pick the real relation (because, so, but) and say it in words.
rules.rationale: The dash chains thoughts without stating how they relate. Swapping it for a semicolon, colon or spaced hyphen keeps the same move.

hit: The fix works — the tests agree.
clean: The fix works because the tests agree.

rules.message: En dash or figure dash in prose.
rules.repair: Split clauses into sentences. A digit-to-digit range such as 2020–2024 is exempt.
rules.rationale: The rule flags every en dash outside code except a range between two digits, which the twin exempts.

hit: The release covers builds – old ones too.
clean: The release covers 2020–2024 builds.

rules.message: Middle dot used as a separator.
rules.repair: Use a comma, a new sentence, or a list.
rules.rationale: A spaced middle dot packs several facts into one line without saying how they relate.

hit: Build 14 · passed · two warnings
clean: Build 14 passed with two warnings.

rules.message: Zero-width character in text.
rules.repair: Delete the character.
rules.rationale: Invisible characters can hide a banned word from a reader or a checker.

hit: The word de​lve is split.
clean: The word is whole.

rules.message: Parenthetical that holds a quoted entity name.
rules.repair: Name the entity in the sentence, or define it once in its own sentence.
rules.rationale: A quoted name in brackets hands the reader a label they never saw defined.

hit: The owners (the "Atlas" group) approved it.
clean: The owners approved it.

rules.message: Bold label at the start of a list item.
rules.repair: Write the item as a plain sentence that states the point. Drop the label.
rules.rationale: Bold-label bullets turn prose into a slide deck and hide the relation between items. The detector covers colon inside or outside the bold, dash forms, every bullet marker, numbered items and list-item HTML.

hit: - **Status:** done
1. **Check**: passed
* **Risk** - low

clean: - Use **caution** here
- The status is done.

rules.message: 'See Also' heading near the top of the document.
rules.repair: Put related links at the end under a plain heading, or weave them into the text.
rules.rationale: A link list at the top delays the content. Only the position is flagged; a bottom section is fine.

## See Also

clean:

rules.message: Truncated identifier ending in an ellipsis.
rules.repair: Give the full identifier, or a name the reader can look up.
rules.rationale: A cut-off hash or id cannot be searched or pasted.

hit: See commit 3fa91c2e... for the fix.

rules.message: Opener that describes the text instead of starting it.

rules.rationale: Announcing the document delays its content.

hit: This document records the cache design.
clean: The cache evicts the oldest entry first.

rules.message: Bare URL in prose.
rules.repair: Link a short descriptive anchor, or put a literal endpoint in code ticks.
rules.rationale: Raw addresses break the reading line and often render as widgets.

hit: Read https://example.org/docs/start for details.
clean: Read `https://example.org/api` as a literal.

rules.message: Autolink in angle brackets.

hit: See <https://example.org/guide> now.
clean: See the [setup guide](https://example.org/guide) now.

rules.message: Link whose anchor text is a URL.
rules.repair: Use words that say where the link goes.
rules.rationale: The anchor repeats the address and tells the reader nothing.

hit: See [https://example.org/a](https://example.org/a) now.
clean: See [the guide](https://example.org/a) now.

rules.message: Candour frame that splits the message into spin and truth.
rules.repair: Delete the frame and state the plain fact.
rules.rationale: Announcing honesty implies the rest was not honest.

rules.message: Narration of rule compliance instead of the content.

rules.message: Semicolon joining clauses in prose.
rules.repair: Make two sentences, or state the relation (because, so, but).
rules.rationale: A semicolon often replaces a banned dash and keeps the same unbuilt relation. Lists of comma-bearing items are exempt.

rules.message: Spaced hyphen used as a dash.

rules.message: Double hyphen used as a dash.
